notes.title: Blood of Mehran - Releases October 7th
notes.notes: [p]The sands shift, the bones bleach, but vengeance never drifts from its course...[/p][p][b]Mehran begins his journey on October 7th[/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="iPTk65s7SWI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Anger, vengeance, and corruption have poisoned the kingdom of Aura and claimed many innocent souls. Consumed by grief, Mehran, a battle-tested former soldier, vows to avenge the murder of his lost love, no matter the cost. Paint the streets crimson as the legendary warrior claws his way to the malevolent king’s throne.[/p][p align="start"]Battle physical and mental trials as sinister forces from Mehran’s past attempt to draw him into a dark, nightmarish existence. Fend off inner demons while taking down royal guards in brutal hack-and-slash combat. Wield a deadly array of bladed and ranged weapons to decimate foes near and far. Advance Mehran’s combat skills through a dynamic skill tree with branching paths and progression options.[/p][p align="start"]Experience a timeless tale of love, loss, and loyalty. Dart across beautifully realistic landscapes to a thematic soundtrack featuring a complex combination of traditional Persian vocals and instruments mixed with modern electronica. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Make sure to Wishlist to prepare for the fight![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714530/Blood_of_Mehran/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
